verdict.rationale: Docs clearly show LoRA and full fine-tuning support, launching fine-tuning jobs via console/API/CLI, and deploying the resulting fine-tuned model to a dedicated endpoint for inference (together-ai-docs-11, docs-17, docs-18, docs-23, docs-28, docs-36). This covers train-then-serve workflows but the evidence doesn't confirm a direct 'bring your own externally-trained weights/adapter' upload path independent of Together's own fine-tuning job. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of uploading pre-existing external model weights or LoRA adapters (not produced via Together's fine-tuning job) and any file/artifact upload API for arbitrary checkpoints.
